items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I can’t imagine people tossing out Coltrane. Coltrane will never be tossed out for Pete’s sake.

ctx.x: any of the old layers. If we do that we’d better be prepared to toss out all of today’s music in fifty years.
I can’t imagine people tossing out Coltrane. Coltrane will never be tossed out for Pete’s sake.
Well we say that and we hope not.
